title: Director, Executive Engagement
description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Syndio is the platform more than half the Fortune 100 trust to govern pay decisions, built on a decade of pay equity work and millions of pay records. Executive Engagement & Insights is the team that turns that into research, category leadership, and executive-level experiences elevating pay to a strategic decision rather than a compliance afterthought.

A CHRO or CFO decides to buy our platform once. Inspiring them to feel personally invested in what we’re enabling for their business takes something special, and that is what separates a vendor from a valued business partner. This role exists to help build that.

We're hiring a Director of Executive Engagement to own three things. The first is our Strategic Advisors program, along with an expansion launching later in 2026. You'll onboard advisors, keep them genuinely engaged, and nurture those relationships into outside credibility, introductions that open doors, and sharper strategic thinking. The second is the experience we create for executives among our customers. Working sessions, private briefings, peer roundtables, and executive forum programming that earns time from people who guard it closely and inspire leadership action related to pay governance. The third is our relationships with industry analysts, keeping them informed on Syndio and tapping into their expertise and insights.

You'll report to our SVP of Executive Engagement & Insights and work regularly with our CEO, and the senior leadership team. You'll also work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product to connect them with customer executives, advisors, and analysts in ways that expand opportunities for the business and drive revenue.

Why this job is exciting

•
Build the advisor bench . Identify who we need, drive recruiting efforts, and design a sustainable rhythm that keeps senior executives willing to contribute year after year.

•
Design what executives remember. Create and continually refine working sessions, briefings, and executive forum programming that changes how a leader thinks about pay.

•
Turn access into revenue. Match the right executive to the right moment with Marketing and Sales, and get senior leaders invested before there's a deal on the table.

•
Influence at the highest levels. Build relationships with exceptional senior leaders and work directly with Syndio ’s senior leadership team.

•
Sharpen how we see the market. Industry analysts talk with buyers and vendors all day. You’ll bring what they see back to our leadership team and help influence our plans around it.

About you

• A track record working with senior executives at multi-national enterprises. You've earned time from people who guard it, and held onto it well beyond a single meeting.

• A record of relationships that produced business outcomes. Intros that became pipeline, advisors who influenced a decision, execs who became advocates. You can point to what came of them.

• Strong design instinct. You've built executive experiences and programming content from scratch. While you sweat the details of the room, you always measure the work by the specific value a leader walks away with.

• Influence without authority.

title: Account Manager - EMEA
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role
As an Account Manager, you will drive growth across Kpler’s existing Financial Services clients in EMEA. You will own a portfolio of accounts, act as the commercial partner clients rely on, and take upsell and cross-sell opportunities through to close, deepening how clients use our commodity and maritime intelligence.
This is an account management role with real commercial ownership: you won’t just manage relationships, you’ll identify, negotiate and close growth within them. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Market Analysts and Customer Success, and your insight into what clients need will directly shape our strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Own Your Account Portfolio: Manage a portfolio of Financial Services accounts, responding to client requests promptly and thoroughly, and meeting or exceeding annual sales growth targets.
Own the Expansion Sales Cycle: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your accounts and take them through the full sales cycle, from discovery and proposal to negotiation and close.
Be a Commercial Partner: Support clients with budgeting, multi-year planning, demand planning, reporting and key metrics, helping them get the most from their investment in Kpler.
Negotiate & Close: Negotiate contracts and terms to secure profitable agreements, in line with company policy.
Gather Market Insight: Collect feedback on our products and competitors directly from clients and feed it back to Product and leadership to inform strategy.
Forecast & Maintain the CRM: Keep CRM notes and updates accurate, and work with the Sales team to maintain achievable forecasts.
Collaborate Across the Business: Support cross-functional teams, share expertise, and contribute to company-wide projects and initiatives.
Represent Kpler: Act as a professional, credible face of the company with clients and externally, including travel as needed.
What we are looking for
Commercial Experience: 3+ years in a commercial role, including account management or sales, within technology, SaaS, or data/analytics environments, with exposure to the full sales cycle from opportunity identification through to close.
EMEA Market Experience: Experience managing or selling to clients across EMEA, with an understanding of how buying behaviour, procurement and regulation vary between markets.
Multilingual Skills: Fluency in additional European languages, particularly French, is a strong plus
Communication & Negotiation: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, plus strong negotiation ability.
Drive & Mindset: A proactive, commercial mindset, high self-motivation, and the discipline to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment.
Team Orientation: A collaborative approach focused on long-term success for the client, the team and the business.
Nice-to-haves:
Financial Markets Knowledge: Experience in or familiarity with financial markets.
Commodities Knowledge: Understanding of commodities markets and trends.
Maritime Exposure: Experience in the maritime space.
Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

title: Workplace Project Manager
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Workplace Project Manager, you'll take our workplace playbooks and standards and turn them into delivered projects and programs on the ground - office moves and openings, and global special projects like health & safety programming, design standards, emergency response planning, WVPPs, sustainability, and new tooling rollouts. This is a hands-on delivery role: you own scope, schedule, and budget for each project or program and drive it from kickoff to close.

Where the program sets the standard, your projects and programs bring it to life - on time, on budget, and to spec.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Global Special Projects

- Project manage Workplace's global special projects: health & safety (H&S) programming, global design standards, global emergency response programming, Workplace Violence Prevention Plans (WVPPs), and sustainability programming across Harvey's office portfolio.

- Partner with Security, HR, Legal, and regional Workplace leads to build and roll out emergency response plans and WVPPs that meet local regulatory requirements while staying consistent with Harvey's global standards.

- Maintain and evolve global design standards (furniture, finishes, signage) so offices feel consistently "Harvey" as we scale into new markets.

- Drive sustainability initiatives across offices - vendor and materials selection, energy and waste programs - and track progress against goals.

- Own the global rollout of Workplace tooling and software - evaluating, piloting, and implementing platforms like desk booking, occupancy, and ticketing, and driving stakeholder training and adoption.

- Own global and national vendor contracts (F&B, janitorial, plants, and similar categories) - procurement, negotiation, and the master vendor relationship - while regional workplace managers own the day-to-day relationship, performance, and feedback in their offices.

Global Playbook & Portfolio Management (Moves & Openings)

- Build and maintain the FDOB checklist and playbook that regional workplace leads execute against for satellite moves, expansions, and new-office openings.

- Own the portfolio-level calendar tracking when and where expansions and new offices are happening across the org, so Workplace can sequence and resource projects appropriately.

- Step in to lead a move, opening, or buildout directly where a region doesn't yet have an established workplace manager, or where the existing regional team doesn't have the bandwidth - expect this to be a shrinking share of the role over time as regional coverage matures.

- Coordinate with IT, Security, and AV to keep day-one readiness standards current in the playbook, so regional teams can deliver consistently without you running each project personally.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Elation is a cloud-based clinical platform for independent primary care practices. We want doctors spending their time on patients, not paperwork.
We're hiring full-stack engineers for our billing team.
Billing is a challenging domain. We receive data from insurers and partners who each follow the standards a little differently, but we need to make billing simple for our customers regardless of their payer arrangements and chase down every dollar we can for them across denials. We're using LLMs to take over a lot of work people currently do by hand. You'll design, build, and run these systems yourself.
If that sounds interesting, apply even if you don't check every box below.
What the work looks like

• Building systems that balance financial transactions between insurance, patients, and the practice. We’re building complex solutions that maximize reimbursement for practices and get them paid more while removing complexity for them.

• Working with inconsistent data from outside partners and handling the edge cases well

• Shipping AI features that real users depend on, and figuring out how to tell when they're wrong

• Improving a mature codebase while customers are using it every day

• Owning your work in production and working with Support when something breaks

• Collaborating with product and design to identify improvements and make them rapidly

Your first 60 days

• Ship something to production

• Scope and build a new feature with Product and Design

• Learn our stack and enough of the billing domain to be functional

• Join code reviews and production support

• Engage with customers and learn from their feedback

6-12 months in

• You own big features; collaborating with design and product stakeholders all the way through deployment, monitoring, and collecting insights on adoption

• You help set technical direction for your team on problems that you own

• Support teams, product owners, and sales representatives know you as someone who gets production issues resolved quickly and can speak to the solutions natively

Who we're looking for
You like owning a problem from start to finish. You think about how things will fail before they ship. You can identify when a problem needs a proper fix versus when a simple bandaid will do. You don't need to know healthcare billing already, but you're happy to learn it and to ask the experts a lot of questions. You can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers. And you already use AI tools in your own work.
How we work
Each team has several engineers, an engineering manager, a product manager, and a designer. Engineers make the technical calls and work with Product on scope and priorities.
Requirements
Essential

• 5+ years of professional software development (8+ for Staff, including technical leadership)

• Production experience building and running backend services and APIs

• Comfortable working across the stack and in more than one language

• Experience with alerting/observability/instrumentation for real production solutions

• Clear communicator with technical and non-technical people

• Interest in building with LLMs

Nice to have

• Experience building production features with LLMs or machine learning

• A data-driven mentality

• Python and/or PHP, and MySQL

• TypeScript and React

• Payments, financial, or ledger systems

• Event-driven or distributed systems on AWS

• Observability and DevOps

• US healthcare, especially medical billing or claims

Everyone Is Welcome

We’re looking for someone who is passionate, motivated problem-solver. Come join TNC and apply today!

• Experience working with integrated Human Resources Management Systems, preferably Workday HCM.

• Experience coordinating and leading projects.·

We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.
One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply - we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. A Teya azért létezik, hogy ezen változtasson.

Olyan, egész Európa-szintű pénzügyi platformot építünk a helyi vállalkozásoknak, ahol az egyszerű eszközök, az átgondolt dizájn és a valódi emberi segítség áll a középpontban. Partnereink biztos támaszként számíthatnak ránk a cégük menedzselésében, ez a felelősség pedig a mindennapi munkánk alapja.

A dinamikus fejlődésben hiszünk, nem engedünk a minőségből, és a legkisebb részlet felett sem siklunk át. Hisszük, hogy a kimagasló teljesítmény és a valódi vendégszeretet kéz a kézben jár.

Ha szeretnél értékteremtő termékeket fejleszteni, valódi problémákra megoldást találni, és megbízható partnere lenni a helyi vállalkozásoknak, nagyon várjuk a jelentkezésedet!

Miért dolgozz velünk:

Értékesítési képviselőként kulcsszerepet vállalhatsz abban, hogy a magyar kis- és középvállalkozások digitális fejlődését támogasd. Nálunk nemcsak terméket értékesítesz - valódi, hosszú távú partnerségeket építesz, és aktívan formálod ügyfeleink jövőjét.

- Önálló, proaktív munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

- Ambíció, motiváció és könnyed kapcsolatteremtő készség

- Célorientált, versengő személyiség, aki szenvedéllyel dolgozik a sikerért

- Pozitív, rugalmas hozzáállás és megoldásközpontú gondolkodás

- Folyékonyan beszélsz angolul és magyarul

Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel értékesítési tapasztalattal, valamint kiterjedt kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás vagy kapcsolódó szektorok területén.

Amit kínálunk:

- 5 terápiás vagy coaching alkalom évente

Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. title: Chief Engineer

Chief Engineer

Are you ready for your next career challenge?..

Role overview:

• Set engineering direction, technical guardrails and decision routes across capability teams and suppliers.

• Provide independent technical judgement when delivery, cost, schedule, risk and customer outcomes require trade-offs.

Primary responsibilities:

• Own the ESCS engineering strategy, technical baseline, engineering management plan and technical decision record.

• Lead multidisciplinary engineering across architecture, software, integration, data, cloud infrastructure, security, test and service readiness.

• Translate customer outcomes and operational scenarios into technical priorities, increments and engineering acceptance criteria.

• Chair technical and design reviews and assure high-level and low-level designs, interfaces and non-functional requirements.

• Maintain technical authority over solution integrity, configuration, interfaces, technical debt and engineering risks.

• Identify the skills, supplier inputs, dependencies, assumptions and assurance evidence required for delivery.

• Align technical estimates, WBS/PBS content, resource assumptions and technical milestones with the integrated programme plan.

• Drive repeatable deployment, automated testing, configuration management, observability, security and documentation practices.

• Provide technical coaching and delegated authority while retaining accountability for the overall engineering solution.

• Support customer demonstrations, bids and investment decisions with clear evidence of feasibility, maturity and residual risk.

Required skills and capabilities:

• Chief engineering or senior technical authority leadership

• Systems engineering and lifecycle assurance

• Enterprise and solution architecture

• COTS and SaaS integration

• API, event and data-flow architecture

• Cloud-native engineering, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps

• Non-functional requirements, security and operational readiness

• Technical baseline, configuration and interface management

• Technical planning, estimation, risk and design governance

• Senior stakeholder, supplier and multidisciplinary engineering leadership

Required experience:

• Technical authority or engineering leadership for complex systems integration or enterprise platform delivery.

• Leading engineering across multiple disciplines rather than a single technology domain.

• Maintaining the integrity of an end-to-end solution through design, build, integration, verification and transition.

• Converting discovery, prototype or demonstration outputs into an assured production delivery path.

• Influencing senior stakeholders while remaining sufficiently close to delivery to resolve technical constraints.

• Producing and assuring technical documentation, estimates, design evidence and acceptance artefacts.

Desired experience:

• Supply chain, procurement, order management or logistics technology.

• IBM Sterling OMS, Ivalua, planning platforms or comparable COTS products.

• AWS-based platforms, containerised workloads and automated deployment.

• IRAD, bid, demonstrator or product incubation environments.

• Defence, government or security-conscious delivery.

Success in the role :

• The ESCS technical baseline is coherent, controlled and traceable to programme outcomes.

What you’ll do:

- Proven success building relationships, especially with enterprise customers at an executive level.

Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. Job Description
Neogen Corporation is seeking a highly organized and analytical Supply Planner to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing product replenishment and developing supply plans through the review of forecasts, inventory levels, safety stock, and production requirements for both purchased and manufactured goods.

As a key connection between supply and demand, the Supply Planner serves as a primary point of contact across Manufacturing, Production, Sales, Quality, Customer Service, Laboratory, and other business functions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver who is comfortable working with ERP and planning systems, analyzing inventory and supply needs, and communicating across multiple levels of the organization.

What You'll Do

title: Revenue Cycle Manager
description:
Job Description: Revenue Cycle Manager, Integrated Complex Care Associates
About the role
The Billing Manager is the first full-time hire for Integrated Complex Care Associates (ICC) and owns billing, provider enrollment, and billing compliance for the group. You will review and release every claim ICC sends to Medicare, enroll and support the physicians who join, and be the person physician offices and patients call with billing questions.
ICC is a California physician group serving patients with complex health needs, led by each patient's own primary physician. Physicians across California join ICC while keeping their own practices, and ICC bills Medicare for that work under its own group TIN.
What you'll do
Enroll and onboard physicians

• Own provider enrollment: each physician's 855I reassignment to ICC, ICC's 855B practice locations, PECOS and NPPES updates, revalidations, and Medicare EFT and remittance setup.

• Set up each physician's office to submit ICC patients' claims through ICC's payer ID, and confirm the first claims flow end to end.

• Keep ICC's provider roster current as physicians join or leave, including who each physician is paid through.

Support physicians and their offices

• Be the main billing contact for each physician's office: answer questions, run short onboarding sessions, and fix submission problems quickly.

• Walk physicians through their payment reports and how ICC's payments relate to their own practice's billing.

Review and release claims

• Review every claim before it goes to Medicare. Claims arrive from each physician's own practice system through ICC's payer ID, and ICC's system fills in ICC's TIN, the rendering physician's NPI, and the service location in the Stedi billing portal.

• Check each claim's CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, place of service, units, and diagnosis codes, then approve it, correct it, or send it back to the physician's office.

• Release approved claims to Medicare (Noridian, Jurisdiction E) under ICC's TIN, and track every claim to payment or denial.

Coding quality

• Sample claims regularly against the physician's EMR of record (ICC patients only) to confirm the documentation supports what was billed, and track error rates by physician.

• Use Nightingale's HCC view to spot conditions that may be undocumented. Where the record may support one, send the physician a compliant, non-leading query, and code only what the physician documents.

• Give physicians and their staff short, specific coding feedback, and escalate patterns to ICC's physician leadership.

Payments and denials

• Post and reconcile Medicare remittances (835s), work rejections and denials, and file corrections, reopenings, and appeals.

• Answer physicians' and office staff's questions about specific claims, remittance status, and payment reports.

• Reconcile what Medicare pays ICC with what ICC pays each physician or physician's practice.

Support patients

• Call each patient before their first ICC claim goes out to explain how ICC's name will appear on their Medicare statements and whom to call with questions.

• Answer patients' billing questions and resolve their concerns, working with the physician's office as needed.

Run billing compliance

• Screen every rendering physician and billing staff member monthly against the OIG exclusion list and SAM.

• Maintain ICC's billing and coding policies, document audits, and report findings to ICC's physician leadership.

• Identify, report, and return Medicare overpayments within the federal 60-day rule.

• Use access to physicians' EMRs only for ICC patients and only as much as each task needs, under HIPAA.

Reporting
You'll be employed by Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC, which provides management services to ICC and handles your employment, pay, and day-to-day administration. For coding, billing, and compliance decisions, you'll work under the direction of ICC's physician leadership (Kaushik Patel, MD) and follow ICC's approved billing and coding

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. ​

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

title: Software Engineering – Data Engineer (Python & Cloud Databases)
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO ) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
The Opportunity

The my FICO engineering team builds the web applications behind FICO Scores consumer-facing business, and data powers everything we do. We are seeking a Data Engineer to own the SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, and other cloud databases behind my FICO .com, build and run the Python ETL/ELT pipelines that feed our data warehouse and analytics platforms, and prepare data for emerging ML and AI use cases in AWS.
What You’ll Contribute

• Design, build, and operate secure, high-performance SQL Server and Redshift databases that power my FICO .com, from data modeling through production support.

• Build and maintain Python ETL/ELT pipelines that move and transform data across operational systems, the data warehouse, and analytics platforms.

• Explore data in Jupyter notebooks, prepare datasets for ML and AI applications, and turn prototypes into scheduled, monitored production pipelines.

• Tune queries, indexes, and schemas to resolve latency, blocking, and deadlocks on a high-traffic consumer site.

• Use AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agentic workflows, such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate delivery while reviewing and refining their output.

• Work with product and marketing teams to modernize data environments, support analytics and AI use cases, and expand data-driven decision-making.

What We’re Seeking

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated experience in data and database engineering.

• Hands-on Microsoft SQL Server administration, including configuration, security and permissions, backup and recovery, index and statistics maintenance, monitoring, and HA/DR.

• Expertise writing and tuning complex SQL queries and stored procedures, plus PowerShell scripting to automate SQL Server tasks such as backup and restore, environment refreshes, and deployments.

• Strong Python for data engineering (pandas, NumPy, SQLAlchemy, or PySpark) and comfort in Jupyter notebooks, with proven experience building transformation pipelines and data warehouse models.

• Hands-on Amazon Redshift administration and tuning, including distribution and sort keys, workload management, and permissions.

• Experience running and securing data platforms in AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, RDS, or similar), including encryption and access control for sensitive consumer data.

• Workflow orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions, or similar) and CI/CD for database and pipeline code.

• Production ownership, including code review, release management, and on-call support, with strong communication skills and experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

• Experience with data pipelines for AI applications (RAG workflows, vector stores, MCP server integrations), ML tools such as scikit-learn or SageMaker, NoSQL databases, infrastructure as code, BI tools such as Tableau, and/or AWS certifications is a plus.

Our Offer to You

• An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

• The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.

• Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

• An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

• The targeted base pay range for this role is: $84,000 to $132,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO ?
At FICO , you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing field

title: Regional Vice President, Sales APAC
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Regional Vice President to own and lead our APAC business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across Australia, Singapore and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model, and partner ecosystem that takes APAC from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the Global Vice President of Sales and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships, and executive engagement.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Team leadership and performance

- Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across the APAC region

- Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions, and forecast calls with precision and consistency

- Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

- Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

- Own the APAC number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all three sub-regions

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to Global VP of Sales and leadership

- Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

- Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in APAC

Hiring

- Manage multiple open roles across APAC simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment, and closing

- Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

- Define the headcount profile for APAC beyond Q4 and feed into H1 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

- Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across APAC

- Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

- Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

- Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region

- Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across APAC's most important enterprise accounts

title: Sr. Manager, Product Marketing Manager - Public Sector
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara 's Connected Operations platform helps organizations that depend on physical operations - fleets, construction, utilities, public works, and first responders - run safer, more efficiently, and more sustainably.
We're looking for a Sr. Manager, Product Marketing Manager, Public Sector to own the narrative, positioning, and enablement that will define how Samsara wins in government. You'll be the team's expert on how public sector buyers evaluate technology - from the contract vehicles they procure through, to the compliance bar they hold vendors to, to the mission outcomes they're ultimately accountable for.
This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who already understands government and frameworks like FedRAMP and StateRAMP/GovRAMP. The ideal candidate is someone who wants to build a public sector product marketing motion, not just execute inside one that already exists.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S. We prefer candidates based in or near Washington, D.C., or those able to work Eastern time zone hours.
You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will have real-world stakes - helping public agencies keep roads plowed, fleets safe, and essential services running for the communities they serve.

•
You're fluent in how the government buys technology: You understand procurement cycles, contract vehicles, and compliance frameworks well enough to turn them into a go-to-market advantage rather than a blocker.

•
You're energized by building, not just executing: Samsara 's federal go-to-market motion is still being defined - you'll have real ownership over the frameworks, positioning, and playbooks that shape it.

•
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara . We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You'll be surrounded by a high-caliber team that pushes you to do your best work.

In this role, you will:

•
Lead as a player-coach: Manage a direct report while helping build the public sector PMM team's foundation - sharing in the strategic work, coaching for growth, and creating the frameworks that enable the function to scale.

•
Own public sector positioning and messaging: Develop and evolve Samsara 's core narrative for government buyers across federal, state, local, and education segments - grounded in mission outcomes rather than generic product benefits

•
Build Samsara 's federal go-to-market foundation: Partner cross-functionally to define how Samsara approaches the federal market, including messaging and enablement that reflect our compliance roadmap as it evolves

•
Translate compliance into a sales advantage: Understand the FedRAMP authorization process and impact

title: Customer Care Specialist
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.
Jako Customer Care Specialist budeš v první linii téhle zkušenosti. Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

CO OD TEBE POTŘEBUJEME

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role je výhoda

- Výborná čeština je nutnost

- Angličtina je plusem

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

CO Z TOHO BUDEŠ MÍT

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

title: Senior Account Executive - EMEA
description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team - huzzah! We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere - one move at a time .

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be-immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

For relocators employees, our goal is to guide them through every step of their move with a delightful mix of tech, coaching, content, and partnerships which work together to make relocating simpler, faster, and more fun.

For employers, we streamline the entire process of supporting international Mobility into one easy-to-use platform, turning Mobility into a strategic advantage for thriving globally.

Now you know why we’re so passionate about what we do!

About the role

The Senior Account Executive will win new business across the UK and Europe, focusing on fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups alongside larger enterprise mobility deals. You’ll build most of your own pipeline and own the full sales cycle, with a target of 1-2 new pilots per month once ramped, converting successful pilots into full rollouts. A successful candidate is a consistently high-performing, autonomous seller with a track record of generating pipeline and closing complex deals, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to help shape the future of go-to-market at PerchPeek !

Role Responsibilities

Whilst every role in a startup has a degree of flexibility over time, here is what we see as the role’s main responsibilities:

•
Land new logos through pilots - Take fast-growing European scale-ups & enterprises from first conversation to a signed pilot, then convert that pilot into a full rollout.

•
Target clients - Fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups in the UK and Europe (roughly 500 to 5,000 employees). We already work with many of Europe’s fastest growing organisations and are targeting the rest. Once ramped, expect to land 1 to 2 new pilots per month.

•
Enterprise Mobility deals - About a quarter of the role is larger, mobility-led enterprise deals that come from industry events, often through RFPs and longer sales processes.

•
Build your own pipeline - You'll generate most of your pipeline through network, referrals, founders and VCs, trigger-based outbound and events.

•
Playbook input - We're still relatively early in our GTM journey and we'll be counting on you to shape how we win here and pave the way for future AEs.

•
Build the PerchPeek Network - Develop and grow relationships with others in the Mobility industry; be a PerchPeek evangelist and represent PerchPeek at events (online/offline, owned and externally organized).

About You

The type of person we think will be awesome in this role will likely have a track record of the below skills and experience:

• A track record of being a consistently top performing AE - ranked in top 1 or 2 of their team

• Experience running a pilot or proof-of-concept and converting it into a full contract

Performance and Resiliency Engineering Lead, Merchant Services (Senior Vice President or Executive Director)
Merchant Services is hiring an SVP/ED Performance & Resiliency Engineer to improve the performance and stability of critical, high-volume platforms. The role focuses on latency reduction, throughput/TPS improvements, capacity planning, and peak-event readiness , while also strengthening resiliency and release safety.
You will partner closely with application development teams and infrastructure/platform engineering to identify bottlenecks across the stack (application/runtime, database, network, compute, and platform), implement durable fixes, and raise engineering standards through technical leadership, mentorship, and strong cross-team collaboration .

• Strengthen resiliency patterns: timeouts/retries, circuit breakers, backpressure/rate limiting, graceful degradation, and failover readiness.

• Drive safer releases via canary/progressive delivery and automated rollback patterns.

• Optimize containerized workloads across EKS (primary) and ECS/other compute where applicable; drive autoscaling strategy and right-sizing.

Qualifications

• Senior experience in performance engineering for distributed systems and/or SRE-style reliability engineering in production.

The Staff GTM Systems Engineer at LiveKit is the technical owner and architect of the systems that power our go-to-market engine. You'll decide how our GTM stack is designed, what we build versus buy, and where we invest next - and you'll be hands-on building it: Salesforce architecture, integrations, enrichment pipelines, and the agentic workflows that help Sales and Marketing move faster and smarter.

Salesforce is our system of record for revenue, pipeline, and customer data. Rackner is seeking a Cybersecurity & Information Assurance Specialist to strengthen security compliance and operational readiness across mission-critical federal healthcare technology.

• Maintain security-control documentation and supporting STIG and ACAS evidence, contributing to eMASS records and customer security assessments as assigned.

• Advise field engineering and operational teams on applicable security readiness and compliance requirements.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional cybersecurity or information assurance experience supporting DoD environments.

• Professional experience with Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS), and Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS).

• Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.

• Experience supporting Defense Health Agency (DHA) Risk Management Framework (RMF) packages.

• Familiarity with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 practices.

ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Research Grants Coordinator to help run Mercor’s research funding programs. Initially, you’ll be responsible for $10m of funding.

You’ll work closely with our research team and external researchers to move promising projects from initial application through funding, delivery, and publication. You’ll coordinate the day-to-day grantmaking process, build relationships across the research community, and make sure applicants and grantees receive clear, timely support. This role suits someone who is highly organized, enjoys working with researchers, and takes ownership of getting things done.

What You’ll Do

- Coordinate the grant process: Manage applications, organize reviews with Mercor researchers, track decisions, and keep applicants informed.

- Outbound to grantees: Reach out to applicants and potential applicants to make them aware and keep them informed of the grants process.

- Build research relationships: Identify prospective applicants, support outreach to universities and research organizations, and help grow the community around Mercor’s funding programs.

- Communicate results: Coordinate project updates, publications, and announcements, and help the team understand what funded projects have achieved.

- Improve how we work: Build straightforward systems for tracking grants, managing communications, and reporting on program progress.

- Organize events: Organize kickoff, checkin, and wrapup events for grantees and the wider research community.

What We’re Looking For

- Experience: Ideally 2-3 years in program coordination, research operations, grant administration, consulting, or a related role.

- Organization: Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and relationships.

- Communication: Clear, concise writing and confidence working with researchers, applicants, and internal teams.

- Ownership: You follow through, resolve problems independently, and know when to ask for input.

- Research interest: Curiosity about AI research and the ability to understand and summarize a project’s goals and progress.

- Practical judgment: Comfortable handling confidential proposals and funding information, adapting to changing priorities, and improving processes as you go.

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE PRODUCT ENGINEERING TEAM

Product Engineering builds the power and cooling systems that let Fluidstack deliver gigawatt-scale AI data centers faster and denser than the grid-standard supply chain allows. The SST group is designing solid-state transformers as a core building block of that power architecture.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Architect a medium-voltage solid-state transformer that can be manufactured, serviced, and scaled across gigawatt-scale campuses, not just demonstrated in a lab.

- Define the interface between the SST and the MVDC distribution system, including protection, control boundaries, and fault behavior.

- Build a semiconductor and magnetics supply strategy that survives a thin 10kV SiC market over a multi-year horizon.

- Take converter hardware from topology selection through working prototypes on a schedule that data center construction actually depends on.

About MoonPay
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.
The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

About the Opportunity
MoonPay is building a unified identity and KYC platform that can support customers across ramps, cards, virtual accounts and enterprise products.
Today, many financial products treat identity as part of a single onboarding flow. We are building it as a reusable platform capability: a secure identity layer that allows customers to verify once, maintain control of their information and access different MoonPay-powered products without repeating the same journey each time.
This role will help define the architecture and technical direction of that platform. You will work across product, engineering, compliance and security to determine how identity is captured, verified, stored, linked and exposed safely through APIs and SDKs.
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. The problem is not fully defined, and we are looking for someone who can shape the platform while building its most important components.
Lead through ambiguity
Turn a broad identity and KYC vision into a clear technical strategy, architecture and sequence of deliverable work.
Identify the boundaries between identity, authentication, verification, compliance and product-specific onboarding.
Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards and lasting engineering habits.
Align teams across ramps, cards, virtual accounts and enterprise products around a shared identity model.
Build the identity platform
Design a unified identity layer that can support multiple MoonPay products, partners and regulated use cases.
Model the lifecycle of a customer’s identity, including creation, verification, linking, updates, consent and deletion.
Build secure APIs and SDKs that allow internal teams and external partners to use identity capabilities without understanding the underlying complexity.
Integrate KYC and identity-verification providers while keeping MoonPay’s internal model consistent and extensible.
Develop clear ownership boundaries between the identity platform and the products built on top of it.
Protect sensitive customer data
Define how identity data is stored, accessed and shared across products, jurisdictions and legal entities.
Design for consent, auditability, data residency, retention and deletion from the beginning.
Build clear authorisation controls around who and what can access verified customer information.
Ensure the platform degrades safely when external verification providers or internal dependencies fail.
